entries.text: 优化 AI 模型服务，增加重试与错误处理
entries.textEn: Improved the AI model service with retries and error handling

entries.text: 代理慢查询列表支持分页与搜索
entries.textEn: The proxy slow-query list supports paging and search

entries.text: 手动采集支持协作式取消定时任务
entries.textEn: Manual collection can cooperatively cancel the scheduled job

entries.text: 暂停创建锁等待收集作业
entries.textEn: Suspended creation of the lock-wait collection job

entries.text: 慢查询模板新增调优时间字段与平均查询时间筛选
entries.textEn: Slow-query templates gained a tuning-time field and average query-time filtering

entries.text: 重构锁等待迁移脚本，分离配置与数据初始化
entries.textEn: Reworked the lock-wait migration script, separating configuration from data initialisation

entries.text: 分片列表支持按实例 ID 筛选，流式查询改为分页
entries.textEn: The shard list can be filtered by instance ID, and streaming queries became paged

entries.text: 优化 TDSQL 代理慢查询的处理性能与异常处理
entries.textEn: Improved performance and exception handling for TDSQL proxy slow queries

entries.text: 慢查询表字段类型改为 BIGINT，避免数据溢出
entries.textEn: Slow-query table columns changed to BIGINT to prevent overflow

entries.text: 新增锁等待分析能力与状态管理
entries.textEn: Added lock-wait analysis and its state management

entries.text: 新增 MySQL 锁等待检测功能与配置步骤
entries.textEn: Added MySQL lock-wait detection with configuration steps

entries.text: 新增锁等待分析的表结构与历史任务迁移脚本
entries.textEn: Added the lock-wait analysis schema and a migration script for historical tasks

entries.text: 新增 MySQL 锁等待分析功能
entries.textEn: Added MySQL lock-wait analysis

entries.text: 支持 webhook 评论回写状态追踪与空 SQL 工单清理
entries.textEn: Webhook comments can write back status, and empty-SQL tickets are cleaned up

entries.text: 支持多监控路径配置，优化 GitHub Webhook 处理
entries.textEn: Configuration supports multiple monitor paths, and GitHub webhook handling improved

entries.text: 支持监控目录过滤
entries.textEn: Added monitor directory filtering

entries.text: 接口审核任务增加索引推荐开关
entries.textEn: API audit tasks gained an index-recommendation switch

entries.text: 新增工单审核失败异常，绑定 task 与 ticket 的关系
entries.textEn: Added a ticket-audit failure exception that binds the task and the ticket

entries.text: 新增数据库克隆工具并完善工具链
entries.textEn: Added a database cloning tool and completed the tool chain

entries.text: 部署包解析支持文本文件自动识别编码
entries.textEn: Deployment package parsing detects text-file encoding automatically

entries.text: 为 MySQL 查询增加超时设置与重试机制
entries.textEn: Added timeouts and retries for MySQL queries

entries.text: 新增 MySQL 数据库结构导出脚本
entries.textEn: Added a script that exports the MySQL database structure

entries.text: 支持从压缩包归档创建查询负载
entries.textEn: Create query loads from archive files

entries.text: 支持通过 ZIP 包上传 SQL 与 XML 文件
entries.textEn: Upload SQL and XML files as a ZIP archive

entries.text: 推荐规则模板 ID 拆分为巡检模板与审核模板
entries.textEn: The recommended rule-template ID split into an inspection template and a review template

entries.text: 为查询负载引入专用线程池，优化创建过程
entries.textEn: Query loads use a dedicated thread pool, improving creation

entries.text: 修正生产环境脚本中的 rule_code 拼写错误
entries.textEn: Corrected a rule_code typo in a production script

entries.text: 新增 SQL 解析异常的存储与展示
entries.textEn: Added storage and display of SQL parse exceptions

entries.text: 修正 SQL 文件中的表名引用错误
entries.textEn: Corrected a wrong table reference in a SQL file

entries.text: 支持通过系统属性控制 ANTLR 解析器线程缓存
entries.textEn: A system property controls the ANTLR parser thread cache

entries.text: 修复 SQL 解析器初始化缺少 useExclusiveParser 参数的问题
entries.textEn: Fixed the SQL parser initialising without the useExclusiveParser parameter

entries.text: 新增独占解析器选项，避免多线程并发问题
entries.textEn: Added an exclusive-parser option to avoid multi-threading problems

entries.text: 工单详情增加审核任务的错误信息
entries.textEn: Ticket details show the audit task's error information

entries.text: 修正规则代码中的拼写错误
entries.textEn: Corrected typos in rule codes

entries.text: 修复解析异常类型不匹配的问题
entries.textEn: Fixed a parse-exception type mismatch

entries.text: 新增审核规则脚本
entries.textEn: Added an audit rule script

entries.text: SQL 语句长度上限由 100KB 提升至 10MB
entries.textEn: SQL statement length limit raised from 100KB to 10MB

entries.text: 改进索引清理的错误解析逻辑
entries.textEn: Improved error parsing for index clean-up

entries.text: 新增 SQL 内容为空的错误码，优化任务失败处理
entries.textEn: Added an error code for empty SQL and improved task-failure handling

entries.text: 修复索引清理返回结果的处理逻辑
entries.textEn: Fixed handling of the index clean-up result

entries.text: 索引清理增加错误历史记录与手动标记解决
entries.textEn: Index clean-up gained an error history and manual resolution

entries.text: 移除索引清理问题表的自增属性
entries.textEn: Removed the auto-increment on the index clean-up issue table

entries.text: 实现索引清理中心功能
entries.textEn: Implemented the index clean-up centre

entries.text: 删除审核模块冗余的规则初始化
entries.textEn: Removed redundant rule initialisation from the audit module

entries.text: 移除解析结果缓存，修复并发修改异常
entries.textEn: Removed the parse-result cache, fixing a concurrent-modification exception

entries.text: 删除审核模块冗余的 sqlparser
entries.textEn: Removed a redundant SQL parser from the audit module

entries.text: 修正审计表字段的注释信息
entries.textEn: Corrected column comments on the audit tables

entries.text: 实现平台权限字典的更新功能
entries.textEn: Implemented updating the platform permission dictionary

entries.text: 同步角色权限变更时更新用户关联的组织范围

entries.text: 平台角色管理支持更新系统角色的权限
entries.textEn: Platform role management can update system-role permissions

entries.text: 实现平台自定义角色的增删改
entries.textEn: Implemented create, update and delete for platform custom roles

entries.text: 新增用户系统角色分配的保存功能
entries.textEn: Added saving of a user's system-role assignment

entries.text: 新增平台角色与权限字典管理接口
entries.textEn: Added endpoints managing platform roles and the permission dictionary

entries.text: 修复空指针异常并增强错误处理
entries.textEn: Fixed a null-pointer exception and improved error handling
